_comment: The terminal `error` event (docs/JSON-PROGRESS-FORMAT.md). `legacy` lines are what an older fisherman sent; a consumer must still read them (message and exit status). Each `cases` entry is a progress.Failure (`failure`) and the event progress.Fail writes for it, without timestamp and elapsed_ms. `secrets` are registered first: no event may carry them.
